title: Software Developer
summary: Software developers design, write and maintain the code behind apps, websites and business systems.
tasks: Design features with users and teams

routes.title: Bachelor of Computer Science or Software Engineering

title: Web Developer
summary: Web developers build and maintain websites and web apps, from page layout to the systems behind them.
tasks: Connect sites to databases and services
Keep sites fast, secure and accessible

title: Data Analyst
summary: Data analysts collect, clean and analyse data, then turn it into reports and dashboards that guide decisions.

routes.title: Degree in statistics, economics, computer science or similar

title: Data Scientist
summary: Data scientists build statistical and machine-learning models to predict outcomes and automate decisions.

routes.title: Degree in statistics, mathematics or computer science
Master's in data science (common, not essential)
